capabilities: Chat with coding agents in a sidebar
Attach notes, selections, images and @-mentions as context
Approve or deny agent permission requests
Run several agent conversations in tabs
Save, search and resume sessions, and export them to Markdown
disambiguation: Not an agent registry or marketplace; it is a chat sidebar that launches coding agents you have already installed.
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.8.7+); mobile is unsupported because the plugin launches local processes. It makes no network requests and sends no telemetry, but agents run as child processes with their own permission modes and can read or write files outside the vault. Conversations are stored in the plugin folder and may be picked up by vault sync or Git.
problem: Using a coding agent on vault notes meant leaving Obsidian and pasting note content into a terminal.

relations.evidence: working with Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and other coding agents from a sidebar
Disabled by default: personal Gemini Code Assist accounts do not support this client.
Use BRAT to try beta versions before they reach the community directory.

requires.name: Coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode)

summary: Sidebar chat for coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex, with notes, selections and images sent as context.
